feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: Breaking news, top national and world stories, politics, business and culture from NPR. Catch up on demand with NPR News Now, Up First and Consider This.

entry.title: Greetings from Baghdad, where Agatha Christie's old home presents its own mystery
entry.summary: The English writer visited Iraq multiple times in the first half of the 20th century and set some of her mystery novels there. The house in Baghdad where she once lived now sits abandoned and crumbling.

entry.title: A stress-free guide to organizing important paperwork and documents
entry.summary: Got piles of mail stacking up in the kitchen? Not sure where your Social Security card is? It might be time to sort through your paperwork. Don't let it overwhelm you with this simple guide.

entry.title: With days to go before the midterms, data shows the U.S. economy is doing well
entry.summary: GDP grew at an annual rate of 3.4% in the third quarter in the last major read on the economy ahead of the midterm elections — but many Americans continue to struggle with affordability.

entry.title: GDP report to give insight before Election Day. And, Israel's election is deadlocked
entry.summary: Economists expect the GDP report to show economic growth, but say that growth is "fragile." And, after 90% of the votes in Israel have been counted, no clear winner has emerged.

entry.title: How AI drones are influencing the course of the Ukraine war
entry.summary: Artificial intelligence is making drones faster and more capable. Russia and Ukraine both use AI-powered drones, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that AI could lead decisions on the battlefield as soon as next year.

entry.title: Tariffs, diesel and computer chips are driving up costs for automakers
entry.summary: American auto companies say they are paying more for key components like computer chips, steel and copper — plus the fuel needed to transport their products.

entry.title: These are the House races to watch in the 2026 midterm election on Nov. 3
entry.summary: An NPR analysis finds 70 House districts where Democrats and Republicans are each investing more than six figures in advertising during the final few days of the election, including in deep red areas.

entry.title: State ballots let voters decide on abortion, taxes, transgender restrictions
entry.summary: Missouri voters could ban abortion - after they just removed a ban two years ago. California voters could tax billionaires 5% of their wealth.

entry.title: Business as a liberal art? Some high schools say yes
entry.summary: Learning about money is becoming a growing part of the high school curriculum.

entry.title: Ahead of midterms, Missourians defend transgender healthcare
entry.summary: The campaign to defend access to transgender healthcare for young people in Missouri is taking an unhurried approach to talking with voters about the proposed ban.
